🇪🇺 Native German turned global citizen, I have more than 10 years of experience in the NYC tech & startup ecosystem. 🗽 Empowering others to do their best work and make a positive impact on the world is my passion. What that looks like in practice:

𝗣𝗮𝘀𝘁:
• designing programming and community for WeWork's startup and SMB members on topics such as fundraising, sales, social impact, leadership (full-time)
• mentoring promising college students from underrepresented backgrounds on their path to college graduation and strong first jobs as a volunteer Leadership Coach at Braven

In my free time, I am an avid yoga student, endurance runner, and traveler: I have lived in 5 countries (traveled to 38) and finished 8 half marathons on 3 different continents. Languages are another subject I am passionate about: I am fluent in English, German, French, and Spanish. Next up: Python & SQL!

positions.title: Co-Founder & Community Lead
positions.description:
Growing and scaling the global Women and Climate Community from 0 to 7000+ members on Slack, and from 1 to 50+ cities around the world. Women and Climate provides a joyful and safe space for women and nonbinary professionals from around the world to learn and talk about climate - no climate experience necessary. 

Our mission is to accelerate climate action by inspiring more women to get started on their climate journey and empowering those who are working on climate today. We do this by bringing women together in community (both online and offline) to support and learn from each other, build their professional networks and form friendships, and by uplifting the voices of women who are working on climate solutions (check out our Speaker Database!). 

Women and Climate is a 501(c)(3) non-profit registered in New York with 50+ local chapters around the world.

positions.title: Global Startup Platform & Programming
positions.description:
WeWork supports the growth of its startup & SMB members through educational programs, mentorship, and access to a global community of >500k members. I am used to wearing many different hats: my role includes program strategy and operations, end-to-end project management, marketing strategy, community building, speaker sourcing, partnership management, stakeholder relations, as well as KPI tracking and program evaluation. 

To date, I have designed and spearheaded more than 20 flagship programs, e.g.:
• 𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗔𝗰𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗺𝘆: a three-month personal growth & career development bootcamp with 500+ participants globally
• 𝗥𝗲𝗮𝗱𝘆 𝘁𝗼 𝗥𝗮𝗶𝘀𝗲: a three-month fundraising program for 100 select startups worldwide followed by a virtual demo day attended by 150 investors
• 𝗙𝗲𝗺𝗮𝗹𝗲 𝗙𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗿𝘀 𝗖𝗶𝗿𝗰𝗹𝗲: community for women entrepreneurs in NYC
• 𝗦𝗼𝗰𝗶𝗮𝗹 𝗜𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗰𝘁 𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗺𝘂𝗻𝗶𝘁𝘆: workshop series, founders circle program, and global Slack community for socially responsible, mission-driven entrepreneurs & innovators
• 𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗻 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝘁 𝗕𝗼𝗼𝘁𝗰𝗮𝗺𝗽: a 6-week course on how to build a tech product 
• 𝗦𝗮𝗹𝗲𝘀 𝗔𝗰𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗺𝘆: a 10-week sales bootcamp covering B2B & B2C sales run in three different regions & time zones simultaneously, in collaboration with HubSpot
• 𝗕𝘂𝘀𝗶𝗻𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝗚𝗿𝗼𝘄𝘁𝗵 𝗕𝗼𝗼𝘁𝗰𝗮𝗺𝗽: a five-week global speaker series in partnership with DC Startup Week
• 𝗖𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗺𝗲𝗿 𝗘𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗕𝗼𝗼𝘁𝗰𝗮𝗺𝗽: a three-week series in partnership with Zendesk

Since 2022, I am also a certified WeWork Learning Ambassador. In this capacity, I assist WeWork's Global Learning Team in delivering live sessions such as New Hire Orientations and Introduction to Member Experience workshops. I put a special focus on creating a safe, inclusive learning environment and serving as a role model of WeWork's values.
